# Libraries and data

```{r}
library(conflicted)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggTimeSeries)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
```

conflicted::conflict_scout()

## Data

Physico-chemical variables :

```{r}
gravelines_environment <- read.csv2(
  here("Data/Raw/Q2_IGA_GravA_ENV_SEANOE.csv")
)
```

Climatological data (from Météo France). Data available at : https://meteofrance.s3.sbg.io.cloud.ovh.net/data/synchro_ftp/BASE/MENS/MENSQ_59_previous-1950-2024.csv.gz

```{r}
climatological_data <- read.csv2(
  here("Data/Raw/MENSQ_59_previous-1950-2024.csv")
)
```

North Atlantic Oscillation and East Atlantic Pattern. Data available at https://climatedataguide.ucar.edu/sites/default/files/2026-04/nao_pc_monthly.txt (NAO) and https://ftp.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/wd52dg/data/indices/ea_index.tim (EAP).

```{r}
nao_data <- readLines(here("Data/Raw/nao_pc_monthly.txt"))
eap_data <- readLines(here("Data/Raw/ea_index.tim"))
```

# Clean data

## Physico-chemical variables

```{r}
gravelines_environment <- gravelines_environment |>
  select(
    Passage...Date,
    Resultat...Code.parametre,
    Resultat...Valeur.de.la.mesure,
    Resultat...Symbole.unite.de.mesure.associe.au.quintuplet
  ) |>
  rename(
    date = Passage...Date,
    variable = Resultat...Code.parametre,
    value = Resultat...Valeur.de.la.mesure,
    unit = Resultat...Symbole.unite.de.mesure.associe.au.quintuplet
  ) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
    value = as.numeric(value)
  ) |>
  filter(date >= "1998-01-01")
```

Look at the units for each variable :

```{r}
gravelines_environment |>
  select(variable, unit) |>
  filter(!duplicated(paste(variable, unit)))
```

Some measures of NO~3~ and NO~3~+NO~2~ have no unit associated. However we won't be keeping those variables (see later) so that is not a problem.

Convert dataset to wide format :

```{r}
gravelines_environment <- gravelines_environment |>
  select(-unit) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value) |>
  group_by(year = year(date), month = month(date)) |>
  summarize(across(everything(), ~ mean(., na.rm = TRUE))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-c(year, month))
```

```{r}
nrow(gravelines_environment)
```

This dataset has 324 rows, that is one for each month from 1998-01 to 2024-12. We don't need to compute monthly means.

Standardize dates to be on the first day of each month :

```{r}
gravelines_environment <- gravelines_environment |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(paste(year(date), month(date), "01", sep = "-")))
```

Check percentage of missing data

```{r}
missing_values <- gravelines_environment |>
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarize(`missing_%` = sum(is.na(value)) / n()) |>
  arrange(`missing_%`)
```

```{r}
missing_values
```

Only four variables have no missing data : temperature, ammonium (NH4), chlorophyll a and phaeopigments. The other variables have too many missing values to be imputed, so we remove them.

```{r}
gravelines_environment <- gravelines_environment |>
  rename(
    "temperature" = TEMP,
    "NH4" = NH4,
    "chlorophyll_a" = CHLOROA,
    "phaeopigments" = PHEO
  ) |>
  select(date, temperature, NH4, chlorophyll_a, phaeopigments)
```

```{r}
head(gravelines_environment)
```

## Climatology

Newer versions of the datasets may impact the values of NAO and EAP indices : "As is the nature of PC-based indices, every time additional data is used to compute the EOF the individual PC values will likely change." (https://climatedataguide.ucar.edu/climate-data/hurrell-north-atlantic-oscillation-nao-index-pc-based).

The datasets used here were retrieved on november 2nd, 2026.

### NAO

```{r}
nao_data <- nao_data |>
  str_split("\\s+")
```

```{r}
nao_data <- as.data.frame(
  as.matrix(do.call(rbind, nao_data[-1]))
)
```

```{r}
colnames(nao_data) <- c("year", paste(1:12))
```

```{r}
nao_data <- nao_data |>
  pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "month", values_to = "nao") |>
  mutate(
    date = ymd(paste(year, month, "1", sep = "-")),
    nao = as.numeric(nao)
  ) |>
  select(date, nao) |>
  filter(date >= as.Date("1998-01-01") & date < as.Date("2024-12-31"))
```

```{r}
head(nao_data)
```

### EAP

```{r}
eap_data <- eap_data |>
  str_split("\\s+")
```

```{r}
eap_data <- as.data.frame(
  as.matrix(do.call(rbind, eap_data[-c(1:9)]))
)
```

```{r}
colnames(eap_data) <- c("year", "month", "eap")
```

```{r}
eap_data <- eap_data |>
  mutate(
    date = ymd(paste(year, month, "1", sep = "-")),
    eap = as.numeric(eap)
  ) |>
  select(date, eap) |>
  filter(date >= as.Date("1998-01-01") & date < as.Date("2024-12-31"))
```

```{r}
head(eap_data)
```

### Météo France

```{r}
climatological_data <- climatological_data |>
  filter(NOM_USUEL == "DUNKERQUE") |>
  select(AAAAMM, RR, FFM) |>
  rename(
    date = AAAAMM,
    precipitations = RR,
    wind_speed = FFM
  ) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(paste0(date, "01"), format = "%Y%m%d"),
    precipitations = as.numeric(precipitations),
    wind_speed = as.numeric(wind_speed)
  ) |>
  filter(date >= as.Date("1998-01-01"))
```

```{r}
head(climatological_data)
```

# Combine all datasets

```{r}
environmental_data <- gravelines_environment |>
  left_join(climatological_data) |>
  left_join(nao_data) |>
  left_join(eap_data)
```

```{r}
head(environmental_data)
```

Store the units of each variable in a separate dataset

```{r}
environmental_data_units <- tribble(
  ~measure         , ~unit       ,
  "nao"            , "arbitrary" ,
  "eap"            , "arbitrary" ,
  "precipitations" , "mm"        ,
  "wind_speed"     , "m.s-1"     ,
  "temperature"    , "°C"        ,
  "NH4"            , "µmol.L-1"  ,
  "chlorophyll_a"  , "µg.L-1"    ,
  "phaeopigments"  , "µg.L-1"
)
```

```{r}
environmental_data_units
```

# Export data

```{r}
write.csv(
  environmental_data,
  here("Data/Temp/environmental_data.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  environmental_data_units,
  here("Data/Temp/environmental_data_units.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
